answer: An agent economy can use vote-escrowed stake: influence scales with locked capital multiplied by lock duration, like a crystal gaining facets the longer it sits undisturbed. A newcomer locking funds for one epoch stands on a low knoll, while a veteran locked for a year reaches the zenith of voting weight. A sybil farmer must lock separate capital for a long time per fake, and locked funds cannot be recycled between identities, so cloning identities multiplies the capital bill while honest agents earn weight by simply staying committed.
